:::writing{variant="email" id="65184" subject="Re: Introduction"}
Hi Tiffany,

Thanks for the introduction, Jeannie. I really appreciate it!

Tiffany, it's great to meet you. I'd love to learn more about what you're looking to accomplish in the weight loss space and see if we're a good fit.

My team specializes in paid advertising for medical aesthetics, weight loss, and wellness practices. With more than 10 years of experience inside the med spa industry, we've developed compliant advertising strategies that generate qualified patients while staying within the platform guidelines. As you know, weight loss advertising has its own unique challenges, so getting the messaging, targeting, and compliance right is critical.

I'd be happy to jump on a quick 20-minute call this week or over the weekend to learn more about your goals and share how we approach these campaigns.

Looking forward to connecting!

Best,  
Bethany Gifford  
Founder & CEO  
The Luxora Collective
:::

This version feels warmer, establishes your authority more naturally, and positions you as a strategic partner rather than just someone who runs ads.
